title: Logic Gates
summary: Ask TRUE/FALSE questions of every value, count with sum(), and filter with [ ].
hints: `scores >= 60` gives TRUE or FALSE for each score. Store that in `passed`.
TRUE counts as 1 and FALSE as 0, so `sum(passed)` counts the passes and `mean(passed)` gives the proportion.
Put a condition inside the brackets to keep only matching values: `scores[scores >= 80]`.
